allocation.summary: Initialize the selected tracker slot as canonical_v2, resolve the S00 registered executor, build the song candidate set from the Core Benchmark Data Center, then stop at HG01 for the human song-aesthetic decision.

S00_SLOT_CREATED.summary: Resolve the S00 executor, build or refresh the Core-Database song candidate set and immediately run HG01; do not start BGM or visual work before HG01 PASS.

S01_HG01_SONG_LOCKED.summary: Resolve the S01 executor, discover the exact Douyin-native audio asset and listening variants, then stop at HG02 for BGM lock.

S02_HG02_BGM_LOCKED.summary: Use the registered CANONICAL_AUDIO_TIMELINE_TOOLCHAIN to build and machine-validate the trusted Audio Timeline Package from the locked BGM before any timing-dependent director work.

S03_AUDIO_TIMELINE_LOCKED.summary: Resolve the S03 creative-synthesis executor and convert locked audio truth into semantic Natural Beats without introducing visual design yet.

S04_NATURAL_BEAT_LOCKED.summary: Resolve the S04 Director executor, allocate lyric-hit visuals, camera-subject relationships, environment events and source roles into the Director Beat Map and Director Plan.

S05_DIRECTOR_PLAN_LOCKED.summary: Resolve the First Frame capability-handoff executor, generate separate 9:16 K0 first frames from the locked Director Plan, run machine first-frame QA, then stop at HG03 for set acceptance.

S06_HG03_FIRST_FRAMES_LOCKED.summary: Resolve the Dynamic Prompt creative-synthesis executor and translate accepted K0 truth into bounded I2V dynamic prompts; K0 pixels outrank superseded prose.

S07_DYNAMIC_PROMPT_SET_READY.summary: Resolve the existing dynamic-generation capability handoff, generate RAW sources, classify PASS/TRIM/REGEN status and produce the Visual Source Map; trim before regenerating.

S08_DYNAMIC_SOURCE_QA_LOCKED.summary: Resolve the deterministic source-normalization executor and apply required multi-shot atomization and/or WEB source rough-cut normalization according to active context before edit.

S09_SOURCE_NORMALIZATION_READY.summary: Reuse the registered Audio Timeline Final Gate to revalidate locked audio identity and duration at editor ingest before building the picture edit.

S10_EDITOR_AUDIO_GATE_PASS.summary: Resolve the Edit Map creative-synthesis executor and build the executable picture Edit Map from normalized source atoms against canonical audio truth.

S11_EDIT_MAP_LOCKED.summary: Resolve the existing preview render capability, render and machine-QA the picture preview, then stop at HG04 for human rhythm acceptance.

S12_HG04_PICTURE_EDIT_PASS.summary: Resolve the locked subtitle implementation executor, apply the accepted baseline and machine-check geometry, padding, bounding boxes and safe placement.

S13_SUBTITLE_IMPLEMENTATION_QA_PASS.summary: Resolve the existing final-render/technical-QA executor, render the candidate and validate codec, duration, audio, watermark safety, aspect ratio and delivery readiness.

S14_FINAL_TECH_QA_PASS.summary: Use the registered Runtime Human Gate path to present the final technically valid candidate for acceptance; do not build the release package before HG05 PASS.

S15_HG05_FINAL_ACCEPTANCE_PASS.summary: Resolve the rule-driven Release Package executor and build publish-ready metadata from the accepted final render and account packaging rules.

S16_RELEASE_PACKAGE_READY.summary: Use the registered transactional publish executor after real-world confirmation; S17 must never be advanced by hand.

S17_PUBLISHED_DATA_COLLECTION_ACTIVE.summary: Use the observed-data review executor to collect real metrics without inventing missing checkpoints, write the post-publish review and only then close S18.

S18_POST_PUBLISH_REVIEWED.summary: This slot is terminal for production; preserve evidence and allocate or resume another slot.
